status: PRE-REGISTERED: hand-authored and committed before any comparison run. Cases, required sets, gates and rules are not edited after results are seen; post-run analyses are labelled as such in the report.
scope_of_oracle: Hand-authored by reading these passages only. It encodes the author's judgement of which whole passages are needed to answer each question from these fixtures. It does not, and is not claimed to, discover semantic dependencies automatically, and it says nothing about arbitrary other documents.

assembly.whole_passages_only: a passage is included whole or not at all; nothing is truncated
assembly.plain: take the method's ranked passages in order; drop a passage whose sha256 equals one already included (recorded as a suppressed duplicate with its own offsets); skip a passage whose block does not fit the remaining budget (recorded as omitted_for_budget) and continue with the next one
assembly.oracle_dependencies: upper bound for a worker that holds this hand-authored dependency map: take the first required set (in oracle order) that shares at least one passage with the method's ranked passages; place the whole set first (document order); if it does not fit, ABSTAIN_BUDGET (never a partial set); otherwise fill the remaining budget as in plain. If no required set shares a passage with the ranking, the outcome is the plain one.

methods.literal: whole passages that contain every query term as an exact, case-sensitive substring (Python `in` on the passage str), in document order; no ranking, no normalisation
methods.fts5_unicode61: SQLite FTS5 table per fixture, tokenize='unicode61' (defaults: remove_diacritics 1, separators per Unicode categories, '_' is a separator); query = every term double-quoted (inner quotes doubled) and joined by spaces, i.e. an implicit AND of phrases; ORDER BY bm25(table), rowid
methods.fts5_unicode61_underscore: same, tokenize="unicode61 tokenchars '_'" so that '_' is part of tokens

outcome_levels.retrieved: the method returned at least one passage; and separately, whether some required set is entirely among the returned passages
outcome_levels.budget_fitting: the assembled context is at most budget_bytes, counting labels and separators (holds by construction; asserted)
outcome_levels.oracle_complete: the assembled context contains every passage of at least one required set, whole
outcome_levels.semantically_reviewed: a human has read the assembled context against the question; false for every result of this benchmark (no human review was performed)

decisions.SUFFICIENT_PER_ORACLE: answerable and some required set fits the budget; still not semantically reviewed
decisions.ABSTAIN_BUDGET: answerable but no required set fits the budget with its labels: never truncate and call it sufficient
decisions.REVIEW_EXTERNAL: the answer depends on text outside these fixtures
decisions.ABSTAIN_NO_EVIDENCE: the fixtures do not answer the question
